item.title: Satellite reveals immense scale of GPS signal tampering
item.description:
📝 Xona's Pulsar-0 navigation satellite has mapped areas of GNSS jamming on Earth with unprecedented accuracy. Pulsar-0 has found that GNSS signals are tampered with more extensively over regions in conflict. (Image credit: Xona)It's not just deliberate jamming and spoofing that can wreak havoc with the precious PNT signal.
🔗 Read more: https://www.space.com/space-exploration/satellites/its-quite-a-bit-more-than-we-expected-satellite-reveals-immense-scale-of-gps-signal-tampering

item.title: AURpocalypse now: a look at the recent AUR attacks
item.description:
📝 Of course, this means that users have to be willing to trust that the AUR package maintainer is not providing anything malicious in the binaries. The model for Copr, OBS, and PPAs is that a user creates a project under their own user namespace; users have to add each repository from one of those services separately. To install niri from Copr, a user has to enable that repos.
🔗 Read more: https://lwn.net/SubscriberLink/1077619/f7b07c5489fdd43a/
